newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cargolux Feb cargo traffic up 9pct.
newsitem.headline: Cargolux Feb cargo traffic up 9pct.

text.p: Cargolux Airlines International said it flew 161.4 million freight tonne- kilometres (FTKs) last month, up nine percent on February 1996.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
The Luxembourg-based cargo airline flew 321.3 million FTKs in the first two months of the year, an increase of 12 percent on the same period last year.
Cargolux operates a fleet of three Boeing 747-400 frighters and is to take delivery of a further two -400Fs later this year.
It also operates four Boeing 747-200Fs, including one on leaseback.
